name: Default
dsl: ?(deck.remaining >= 2) any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) | ?(self.health < 30%) any<heal> @ self | ?(self.beneficial_wards == 0) any<ward>["Aegis"] @ self | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<trap & !aoe & stacks>[potent | "Indemnity"] @ boss | any<blade & stacks>[sharp | "Aegis"] @ self | ?(self.beneficial_auras == 0) any<aura & out_damage> | any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ boss | ?(all(enemies).is_boss == 0) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | any<global> | any<shadow> | any<trap & !aoe>[potent | "Indemnity"] @ boss | any<blade>[sharp | "Aegis"] @ self | pass
description: For one wizard. Heals itself below 30% health and shields itself when it has no shield. Casts stacking buffs before it attacks (Mass Feint, Feint on the boss, a blade on itself, an aura), then hits with AoE, or single-target at the boss, or at a mob once no boss is left. Only casts a global, a shadow spell or a non-stacking buff when it doesn't have enough pips to attack.
